name: Champion
description: The archetypal Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a natural roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus. When you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: Choose a second Fighting Style option from the fighter class list.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks now score a critical hit on a natural roll of 18, 19, or 20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At the start of each of your turns, if you have no more than half of your hit points remaining and at least 1 HP, you regain HP equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 HP.
